1.w: First of all, then, I urge that requests, prayers, intercessions, and thanks be offered on behalf of all people,

2.w: even for kings and all who are in authority, that we may lead a peaceful and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.

3.w: This is good and welcomed before God our Savior,

4.w: since he wants all people to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

5.w: For there is one God and one intermediary between God and humanity, Christ Jesus, himself human,

6.w: who gave himself as a ransom for all, revealing God’s purpose at his appointed time.

7.w: For this I was appointed a preacher and apostle—I am telling the truth; I am not lying—and a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

8.w: So I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or dispute.

9.w: Likewise women are to exercise the same self-restraint, modesty, and self-control. They are not to adorn themselves with braided hair and gold or pearls or expensive clothing,

10.w: but with good deeds that reflect reverence for God whom they profess.

11.w: A woman must learn quietly with all submissiveness.

12.w: But I do not allow a woman to teach or exercise authority over a man. She must remain quiet.

13.w: For Adam was formed first and then Eve.

14.w: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman, because she was fully deceived, fell into transgression.

15.w: But she will be delivered through childbearing, if she continues in faith and love and holiness with self-control.
